verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes only a generic 'Build and test your application' CI/CD doc link and unrelated self-hosted install guides (Linux package, Helm, scaling); there is no mention of GitLab.com's hosted/shared runners or any assurance that runners are managed by GitLab itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of GitLab.com SaaS shared runners, runner fleet management by GitLab, and confirmation devops leads need not provision runner infrastructure.
